decisions.reason: As a semi-hard cheese closely aligned with the firm's existing dairy and cheese know-how, it fits its absorptive capacity well, and its survival beyond launch suggests the firm has learned enough from early market feedback to justify continuing it.

This spicy cheese line builds directly on established cheese-making capabilities and, because it remained visible as its own line, management would likely see it as an adjacent product it can refine and market without stretching knowledge resources too far.

The mild creamy soft cheese appears to complement the firm's narrow organic cheese range and relies on familiar competencies, so in a growing market the firm would likely retain it as a credible, learnable extension of its core offer.
